collection.description: A child asks why two adults enjoy spending so much time together.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why two adults enjoy spending so much time together.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) says people may feel affection and choose to build a life together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that friendship and romance are not the same.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) hears that loving couples can be different genders or the same gender.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) notices that some adults prefer to remain single.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a caregiver, shares a sweet memory of meeting someone special.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns they need not have a crush at all.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) returns happily to games with friends.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: (child) laughs at an awkward first meeting.

c2__text.text: (child) laughs at an awkward first meeting.
